definition: WholeAt f x is the hypothesized undivided spatial allocation of f to the location of bearer x. WholeExclusive adds that two such bearer locations must be the same bearer; this stronger individuation/localization condition is open. It is not inferred from being numerically one.
note: Additive interface for issue #259. Parmenides 130e–131e and 133b–134e, Phaedo 74b–d / 100d–e and Aristotle Metaphysics I.9 motivate these contrasts; none defines the modern typed interface. Sourcing a replacement would require a passage fixing this exact scope.
